row_construction.repeated_measures: the same uid recurs at every position of its block, so rows are not independent; no significance is claimed
row_construction.why_dropped: a degenerate uid is outside the executed scope, so its reading is the untreated one by construction

definitions.transport_flip: support face helped and delayed face harmed
definitions.auc: Mann-Whitney U with average ranks; folds oriented on the train side
definitions.utility: G(S) = sum(g over S) / (all served rows in the fold)

not_computable.gap_period_aligned: the definition asks for the share of context gaps whose within-day phase (period=24) coincides with the horizon's phases, but the horizon is 48 = 2 x 24 steps and therefore covers every one of the 24 phases; the quantity is identically 1.0 wherever a gap exists and 0/0 otherwise, so it separates nothing.  Reported as defined rather than swapped for another definition.

verdict_rules.PATTERN_WEAK: LODO mean in [0.60, 0.70) or folds disagree on direction
